entities.name: Eiko Shizuki
entities.description: Twenty-four-year-old sister of Kaito Shizuki, kami diplomat and senior adviser to the Regent of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker and Eiko's brother, ill-suited to the Imperial lifestyle.

entities.name: Regent of Kamigawa
entities.description: The ruler Eiko served as senior adviser.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The group that adopted Eiko and Kaito after their parents died.

events.summary: Eiko and Kaito's parents die of radiation poisoning and the siblings are adopted by the Imperials.
events.quote: Both of Eiko's and Kaito's parents died due to radiation poisoning under poor work conditions.

events.summary: Eiko picks a role as a kami diplomat early on.
events.quote: she picked a role as a kami diplomat early on

relations.quote: Eiko Shizuki is the sister of the planeswalker Kaito Shizuki
Eiko served as senior adviser to the Regent of Kamigawa
